biggest_catch: Minimum 16-hour Election Day; mandatory training required; training pay only if you also work early voting or Election Day.
catches: Election Day is a minimum 16-hour shift per the official BOE recruitment page.
Must be a registered voter in Maryland and at least 16 years old.
Mandatory training class required; $50 training pay only if you also work early voting or Election Day.
Compensation mailed 6-8 weeks after Election Day.

c1.evidence: Official Baltimore City Board of Elections pages (boe.baltimorecity.gov/boe-election-judges and baltimorecity.gov/boe/our-work/elections/recruitment), opened and read 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: 'Chief Judge: $325.00; Check-in, Provisional Ballot, and Voting Unit Judge: $250.00.' Training: '$50.00 for attending the training session... You must work early voting as directed or election day to be paid for training class.' c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

steps: Confirm you are a Maryland registered voter, 16+, able to work a 16+ hour day.
Submit the Election Judge Interest Application to the Baltimore City Board of Elections.
Serve on Election Day (minimum 16 hours) June 23, 2026 Primary and/or Nov 3, 2026 General; $250-$325 by role plus $50 training.
timing: Minimum 16 hours on Election Day per official BOE recruitment page; mandatory training class duration unstated.
